sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: Mansa Musa was a famous ruler of which empire?
questions.explanation: Mansa Musa ruled the Mali Empire in the fourteenth century.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The Berlin Conference of 1884–1885 is associated with what?

options.B: The end of World War II
options.C: European rules for the partition of Africa

questions.explanation: The conference formalised European imperial rules for Africa.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Nigeria’s amalgamation of Northern and Southern Protectorates occurred in which year?
questions.explanation: The territories were amalgamated in 1914.

questions.question: Nigeria became independent from Britain in which year?
questions.explanation: Nigeria’s independence date is 1 October 1960.

questions.question: Jaja of Opobo is associated with which historical activity?

options.D: Palm-oil trade and resistance to British control

questions.question: The Sokoto Caliphate was established after the jihad led by whom?
questions.explanation: Usman dan Fodio led the early nineteenth-century jihad.
